artifacts.notes: All 150 Psalm chapters plus Translator’s Preface, dedication, Life of Bellarmine and both prefaces. This is the complete historical body served in the HTML, not the unabridged Latin work. The 1866 translation is expressly abridged. The web transcription error compress/express remains unchanged; the facsimile controls quotation. 2613 paragraph/heading blocks retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: John O’Sullivan’s 1866 English translation, including its historical prefatory matter, is public domain in the United States by publication date. This derivative strips the modern host presentation and retains the underlying historical text; no modern authored article or annotation is included.

edition.publication: eCatholic2000 transcription of John O’Sullivan’s James Duffy 1866 English translation
edition.title: Commentary on the Book of Psalms — eCatholic2000 full-text presentation

alternate_titles: Commentary on the Book of Psalms
work.author: Robert Bellarmine
work.description: Bellarmine's verse-by-verse exposition of the Psalms. The 1866 English expression is materially abridged by its translator, who says that he omitted philological discussion, variant readings, and Bellarmine's individual Psalm prefaces; claims drawn from that expression must not be represented as controlling the complete Latin work.
work.title: Explanatio in Psalmos
